note: City of Fort Pierre park on the Missouri River at the mouth of the Bad River, certified as a Lewis and Clark National Historic Trail site. The RV pads are on a small loop at the park's east end, about 90 m from the river across a reed strip; playground, picnic shelter, restrooms and a boat ramp on the Bad River. No parking on the grass. --Claude
